subtitle_or_header: Sigmoid vs Tanh (shared chart header centered above the two charts)

bullets: [1] The range of the sigmoid function is fixed at 0 to 1, whereas the range of the tanh function is fixed at -1 to 1.

[2] The sigmoid function has a slower rate of change than the tanh function, which means that the derivative of the sigmoid function will be smaller than the derivative of the tanh function for a given input
labels: f(x) = tanh(x) = sinh x / cosh x ⇒ f'(x) = 1-f(x)^2
